claim_ceiling: Componentwise public validation of operational ingredients; not a one-dataset estimate of C_A, C_F, or the full same-environment relational theorem.

yuan_2026.panel_message: As unaided discrimination collapses, bees increasingly pay for predictive information while post-request accuracy stays near 0.93.

spaethe_2026.index_definition: R = 1 - p_colour in public conflict-test values
spaethe_2026.panel_message: A secondary visual attribute is largely ignored when colour is sufficient and strongly recruited when colour is difficult.

maboudi_2025.panel_role: qualitative/mechanistic icon: selective sequential inspection of restricted visual regions before commitment

chow_2022.panel_role: qualitative/mechanistic icon: early sample/platform colour switches which later ball-moving action is correct

essenberg_2015.panel_role: closest biological branch-relevance precedent: flower type determines whether size is reward-informative

plotting_rule: Quantitatively plot only Yuan and Spaethe. Use MaBouDi/Chow/Essenberg as labelled mechanistic support; do not meta-analyse heterogeneous effect sizes.
